research_question: Can structured OCR field parsing and necessary-condition completeness recover positive evidence without sacrificing the hard-negative FAR reduction observed in V19?
hypotheses_from_predecessor_holdout: date evidence should compare parsed year-month-day components rather than raw OCR strings
a literal override must be disabled when a high-risk query condition was not extracted

candidate.structured_date_policy: parse components then require exact year-month-day equality
candidate.structured_identifier_policy: exact token boundary and at least one additional extracted condition
candidate.condition_completeness_policy: fallback when a date, identifier, phone suffix, or organization marker is not represented by an extracted constraint
